messages:
elaine: Quick heads-up — link scanner flagged a duplicate snippet that's breaking rendering on a couple KB pages.

elaine: Hit this during smoke test: image 404 + conflicting anchor names caused the sidebar TOC to skip a section.

elaine: Files:
```
/kb/runtime-troubleshooting#example-run
/kb/runtime-quickstart#example-run
``` 

santiago: ugh, thank you for catching. is this from the last snippet consolidation PR?

elaine: looks like it — merged last week by @marie. scanner shows two snippets with identical frontmatter.title and anchor.

link-scanner-bot: Findings summary: 2 duplicate snippet IDs, 1 missing image (cdn.redwood.ai/runtime/diag.png -> 404). Severity: medium.

marie: taking ownership. i'll rename the anchor in troubleshooting to `example-run-troubleshoot` and add a redirect. will open PR in ~20m.

raj: I can quick-fix the image path in that PR if you want. I remember the CDN path changed after the deploy.

marie: yes please @raj! can you also add a small test to the docs smoke suite to catch duplicate anchors? :+1:

raj: yep. I'll add a lint rule entry and a minimal unit check in docs-ci.

elaine: awesome — ping me when PR is up and i'll run the doc preview. thanks!

infra-team: noted — if you add a redirect entry in the PR we'll schedule a short redeploy to pick it up.

marie: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823 — renamed anchor, added redirect + image fix (thanks @raj).

elaine: preview looks good, TOC repopulates and image loads. closing this thread once merge is green.

santiago: nice, good catch everyone :tada:
